vote.question: Community Accountability Resolution [US-MS U.S. Senate]: Cindy Hyde-smith (R) has received $15,232,692 in career campaign contributions (with $4,646,803 this cycle, alongside $168,000,000 in outside Super PAC support led by Elon Musk)—linked to "Private Equity, Speculative Finance & Real Estate Syndicate". Should MS release the community fund to local charities working on affordable housing trusts, predatory-lending legal aid, and household debt relief?
vote.futarchy_thesis: Large campaign contributions create public concern over policy priorities. When Cindy Hyde-smith receives $15,232,692 (with $4,646,803 this cycle, alongside $168,000,000 in outside Super PAC support led by Elon Musk), community members want accountability. This fund lets residents decide whether to direct community resources to local public causes.

question_vars.capture_archetype: Private Equity, Speculative Finance & Real Estate Syndicate
question_vars.lead_patron_clause: with $4,646,803 this cycle, alongside $168,000,000 in outside Super PAC support led by Elon Musk

options: Yes — Send Fund to Local Charities
No — Send Fund to Essential Community Services

outcomes.YES_RELEASE_TO_LOCAL_CHARITIES: Directs 100% of the funds to verified local non-profits working directly on state community needs.
outcomes.NO_RELEASE_TO_COMMUNITY_COMMONS: Directs 100% of the funds to bipartisan, universal local public services (volunteer fire/EMS, veterans' care, food banks, disaster relief).
outcomes.ABSTAIN_LOG_DISSENT: Records resident feedback without moving the vote count.

futarchy_pole_mechanics.leverage_ratio_statement: Every contribution directly empowers community-led funding. Once the campaign pool reaches $10,000, an automatic 60-day countdown begins. When the 60 days expire, all funds go directly to verified local charities or essential community services—zero platform cut.

bounty_if_passed.description: Community Fund for US-MS: Delivers 100% of funds to verified, IRS-registered 501(c)(3) public charities serving MS dedicated to affordable housing trusts, predatory-lending legal aid, and household debt relief. Verified local recipients: HABITAT FOR HUMANITY OF THE MISSISSIPPI GULF COAST INC (US-EIN:208133916); CATHOLIC CHARITIES HOUSING ASSOCIATION OF BILOXI INC (US-EIN:640506632); NORTH MISSISSIPPI RURAL LEGAL SERVICES INC (US-EIN:640581747); SOUTH MISSISSIPPI HOUSING ANDDEVELOPMENT CORPORATION (US-EIN:205640452); GOODWILL INDUSTRIES OF SOUTH MISSISSIPPI INC (US-EIN:640547585). Once the pool hits $10,000, a 60-day timer starts. If YES wins, funds go to these charities; if NO wins, funds go to local community commons (fire/EMS, veterans, food banks).
bounty_if_passed.destination_criteria: All recipient organizations must be active, verified 501(c)(3) public charities registered in US-MS with clean IRS status and direct community impact. Approved charities: HABITAT FOR HUMANITY OF THE MISSISSIPPI GULF COAST INC (US-EIN:208133916); CATHOLIC CHARITIES HOUSING ASSOCIATION OF BILOXI INC (US-EIN:640506632); NORTH MISSISSIPPI RURAL LEGAL SERVICES INC (US-EIN:640581747); SOUTH MISSISSIPPI HOUSING ANDDEVELOPMENT CORPORATION (US-EIN:205640452); GOODWILL INDUSTRIES OF SOUTH MISSISSIPPI INC (US-EIN:640547585).

trigger_conditions: Condition 1 (Activation): The campaign activates its 60-day countdown timer as soon as total contributions reach $10,000 USD (Base USDC).
Condition 2 (Resolution Period): The community vote runs for exactly 60 days from the moment the $10,000 threshold is reached.

Condition 3 (Payout): If YES receives 60% or more of votes, 100% of the funds are sent to the verified state non-profits; otherwise, 100% is sent to universal community services (fire/EMS, veterans, food banks).
